events.title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin
must_haves: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
The output is widescreen and silent.

events.text: I'd like you to make a video of a realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. I've had this kind of scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. What I mean is a silent, 6-second widescreen video, with the whole thing done as one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. I always worry that describing camera movement in words makes it sound more complicated than I actually mean. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.
